body.statement: For every input \((G^{+},H,A,a,Y)\) satisfying the model assumptions, the machine whose schedule contains only \(\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{sc}},\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{fix}},\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{elim}},\Rightarrow_{\mathrm{res}}\) terminates and returns exactly one sound certificate. On each transition the stated local polynomial obligation holds and \(\mu_H\) decreases lexicographically. It returns \((F_H,\mathcal D_H^{\mathrm{den}},\mathfrak D_H)\), with \(O_H(\Theta_H)\subseteq\mathfrak D_H\), if and only if \(T_{a,H}(\theta_1)=T_{a,H}(\theta_2)\) for all \(\theta_1,\theta_2\in\Theta_H\) satisfying \(O_H(\theta_1)=O_H(\theta_2)\); otherwise it returns a support-exact global-twin box. Thus \(F_H\) is partial on the ambient simplex but covers the complete compatible fixed-support image on an identified branch. This strictly completes Algorithms 1--2 of Lee, Ghassami, and Shpitser for the declared fixed-support class without adding a selector context.
body.justification: This remains the field-level target and is not proved by nonresidual progress alone.
body.gap: The exact remaining premise is verifier exhaustion at every interacting-district residual, including exclusion of identified nonrational residuals.
body.consumer: A complete software certificate should not be advertised until that residual premise is proved.
body.proof_tex:
By \(\textnormal{thm:transition-soundness-termination}\), every admitted transition strictly decreases the lexicographic measure \(\mu_H\in\mathbb N^5\). The well-foundedness argument in that theorem rules out an infinite execution. Hence every maximal execution is finite.

The schedule \(\mathfrak P_H\) first chooses one of the four named relations in its fixed priority order and then chooses the lexicographically least eligible token under the canonical encoding. The residual verifier likewise chooses the first passing candidate in encoded order. Thus a state has at most one scheduled successor. If that successor is residual, the transition consumes the sole residual token, sets the terminal flag, emits one certificate, and halts. No later certificate can be emitted. If no transition is accepted, maximality instead leaves a nonterminal state with no verifier-accepted successor. These alternatives are exhaustive for a finite maximal execution.

Suppose a formula certificate is emitted. By \(\textnormal{thm:certificate-soundness}\),
\[
 O_H(\Theta_H)\subseteq\mathfrak D_H,\qquad
 F_H\{O_H(\theta)\}=T_{a,H}(\theta)
 \quad\text{for all }\theta\in\Theta_H.
\tag{22}
\]
If \(\theta_1,\theta_2\in\Theta_H\) satisfy
\(O_H(\theta_1)=O_H(\theta_2)\), then (22) gives
\[
 T_{a,H}(\theta_1)
 =F_H\{O_H(\theta_1)\}
 =F_H\{O_H(\theta_2)\}
 =T_{a,H}(\theta_2).
\tag{23}
\]
Thus the target is constant on every observation fiber.

Suppose instead that a global-twin box is emitted. Its rational endpoints satisfy \(\ell_j<u_j\), so the box is nonempty; for example its coordinatewise midpoint belongs to it. Certificate soundness gives, for any \(b\) in that box,
\[
 \theta_b^+,\theta_b^-\in\Theta_H,\qquad
 O_H(\theta_b^+)=O_H(\theta_b^-),\qquad
 T_{a,H}(\theta_b^+)\ne T_{a,H}(\theta_b^-).
\tag{24}
\]
Equation (24) is an explicit observation fiber on which the target is not constant, so identification fails. It also supplies exact support \(H\) and strict positivity through certificate soundness.

Nothing in the four transition definitions proves that one of the finite residual projection or contrast candidates passes at every irreducible state. Accordingly the preceding argument proves the stated formula implication, twin implication, uniqueness, and finite stuck-state alternative, but not the unsupported converse.

obligation.what_is_open: The sibling-owned all-residual dichotomy must prove that every graphically residual-ready task has a verifier-accepted rational projection or support-exact global contrast.
obligation.obstruction: Neither the frozen candidate-list definition nor the repaired nonresidual compiler excludes an identified residual whose target is fiber-constant but has only a nonrational algebraic representative. The available terminal three-observable contrast does not lift through arbitrary interacting districts and observed descendants.
obligation.attempted: The fixed Lee--Ghassami--Shpitser district and fixing recursion was compiled through every nonresidual case, and the negative route was compared with canonical response-row perturbations plus rational interior mixing. The unresolved step is simultaneous preservation of every supported context after lifting a common contrast, or a proof that the projection library contains a rational circuit in every remaining identified case.
obligation.partial_result:
The nonresidual compiler now has an input-determined progress and termination proof, and successful supported Lee--Ghassami--Shpitser derivations are simulated exactly. Conditional on the still-open assertion that every residual-ready token contains a verifier-accepted projection or contrast, determinism and multiset descent give one terminal certificate. Certificate soundness then yields
\[
 F_H\{O_H(\theta)\}=T_{a,H}(\theta)
 \quad(\theta\in\Theta_H)
\]
on a formula branch, so the target is constant on every fiber of \(O_H\); a returned twin gives two points of one observation fiber with unequal targets. Hence, under residual exhaustion, identification forces the formula branch and nonidentification forces the twin branch. What is not proved is residual exhaustion itself, including exclusion of a fiber-constant target whose observable representative is algebraic but not rational.
